summary: Join our Sustainable Livelihoods and Income Generation Programs Training Course. Learn effective strategies to boost income and support sustainable development.
lede: Livelihood training helps programme teams assess household assets, vulnerability and market conditions to design income-generation support. For programme managers, economic inclusion specialists and monitoring advisers, it builds practical capability in livelihood assessment, market-system analysis and outcome measurement, using tools such as the Sustainable Livelihoods Framework and Theory of Change to guide programme design and review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, manage, finance, monitor, or improve sustainable livelihoods and income generation programmes across development, humanitarian, social impact, and inclusive business settings. It suits experienced practitioners who need stronger tools for market analysis, economic inclusion, programme accountability, and adaptive delivery.
modules: Results Measurement and OECD DAC Evaluation
prerequisites: Working experience in programme design, livelihoods, economic inclusion, enterprise development, monitoring and evaluation, financial inclusion, humanitarian recovery, or social impact delivery is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing budgets, indicators, stakeholder information, and basic income data. No coding or programming is required. Advanced evaluation, econometric, and predictive analytics methods are introduced conceptually rather than taught at implementation depth.
